template: ts_decay_linear(trade_when(greater(zscore(vec_avg({likelihood_score})), 1.5), winsorize(vec_avg({likelihood_score}) - ts_mean(vec_avg({likelihood_score}), 30) * ((vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice})) / ts_mean(vec_avg({exit_price}) / vec_avg({openprice}), 30)), std=4), 0), 5)
idea: 条件信号平滑衰减：对模板1的条件触发结果应用5日线性衰减加权，在保持"高信心才交易"的区间筛选逻辑同时，降低单一交易日噪音，延长信号半衰期以控制换手率。
